packageRules.description: Each npm project's .npmrc sets min-release-age=7, so npm cannot install a version younger than 7 days; wait the same before proposing it
The e2e suite is test tooling: its own group, kept apart from the shipped frontend
Opik's own images in the chart are set by the release, not Renovate
Altinity tags are <year>.<month>.<patch>.<build>.altinitystable; a new year.month line is an upgrade, so it waits for a Dependency Dashboard tick
Python SDK: Renovate moves only the cooldown caps, the `name<=X` lines in setup.py; the requirements themselves are maintained by hand
Python SDK cooldown caps: each moves to the newest release at least 3 days old (the org preset's minimumReleaseAge for pypi), all in one PR on any weekday
Runtimes set in a setup action's with: (node-version, python-version, pnpm version) are the toolchain a job builds or tests with, often deliberately the oldest supported; they move by hand
